buffer_name.description: Buffer solution used for equilibration and loading

salt_name.description: Name of the salt used in the experiment

process_id_field.description: Process identifier as stored in eLabFTW (text field)

pump_speed.description: Pump speed setting used during loading (as entered)

replicates_raw.description: Number of technical replicates per condition (raw value)

resin_mass_raw.description: Mass of resin loaded per well (raw value, typically mg)

ligand_name.description: Name or identifier of the ligand/analyte

total_volume_raw.description: Total liquid volume used per well (raw value, typically µL)

venting_time.description: Venting time setting for the pump/system

incubation_time.description: Incubation time for the loading step

salt_concentrations_raw.description: Salt concentrations as entered (often a semicolon- or comma-separated list)

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of equilibration cycles applied before loading

ligand_concentrations_raw.description: Ligand concentrations as entered (often a semicolon- or comma-separated list)

calibration_curve_slope_raw.description: Slope of the calibration curve (raw value, used to convert absorbance to concentration)

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit for ligand concentrations (e.g. µM, mg/mL)

calibration_curve_intercept_raw.description: Intercept of the calibration curve (raw value)

equilibration_cycle_duration.description: Duration of a single equilibration cycle

number_of_salt_concentrations.description: Declared number of distinct salt concentrations

number_of_ligand_concentrations.description: Declared number of distinct ligand concentrations

analysis_status.description: Status of the loading isotherm analysis (copied from analysis JSON)

analysis_message.description: Summary message from the analysis script

timestamp.description: Timestamp when results were committed to the database

summary.description: Key quantitative outcomes of the analysis

files_processed.description: Number of raw data files that were processed

n_salt_concentrations.description: Number of unique salt concentrations used

n_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of unique ligand concentrations used

n_langmuir_fits.description: Number of Langmuir isotherm fits successfully performed

analysis_metadata.description: Metadata reproduced from the analysis JSON (parsed inputs such as ligand_concs, salt_concs, calibration parameters)

langmuir_fits.description: Per-salt Langmuir fit parameters derived from the CSV output

q_max.description: Maximum loading capacity q_max at this salt concentration

K.description: Langmuir binding constant K at this salt concentration

R2.description: Coefficient of determination R² for the Langmuir fit

data_files.description: Data output files produced by the analysis

analysis_results_json.description: Name of the main analysis results JSON file

tecan_raw_excel.description: Name of the raw Tecan Excel data file used for analysis

aggregated_data_csv.description: Aggregated data per ligand and salt condition

langmuir_fits_csv.description: CSV file containing fitted Langmuir parameters

plots.description: Plot files produced by the analysis

loading_isotherms_png.description: PNG plot of loading isotherms and Langmuir fits

loading_isotherms_pdf.description: PDF plot of loading isotherms and Langmuir fits
